Subject: Marketplace listing: branding & SLA preflight

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for taking this on. We're kicking off the AWS Marketplace listing for Acme Health's telemonitoring product and want to confirm Redwood's requirements for listing assets and support commitments so we can align procurement and legal. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm what branding variants you allow (logo files, trademark footnotes).
- Minimum support window expected for a co-sell listing in EMEA (do you require 24x7?)
- Any specific language you require for SLA/uptime in marketplace copy and the support routing we should show customers.

Attached are our current brand guidelines and a first-pass support matrix. Can you loop in anyone on your side who handles Marketplace copy and compliance?

Appreciate it — aiming to publish the listing by the end of next week.

Best,
Audrey Li
Head of Partnerships — Acme Health

From: dylan.brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: branding & SLA preflight

Audrey — thanks for the materials and timeline. Looping in Marissa (go-to-market/listings) and Ben (legal/compliance) to confirm exact marketplace constraints. Initial responses below — we can tighten once Marissa reviews the brand pack.

Branding:
- We require high-res SVG/PNG for primary logo and a monochrome variant for console thumbnails. Please include clear trademark/copyright statements; if there are co-brand limitations call them out in the doc.
- Marketplace policies disallow implied endorsements (e.g., "endorsed by AWS"). We can help phrase the product blurb to avoid flagged claims.

Support SLA / routing:
- For co-sell listings targeted at EMEA, our default marketplace guidance asks for a baseline support window (Mon–Fri 9:00–17:00 local support) and an optional 24x7 premium offering. We do not *require* 24x7 for listing — but some channel partners request 24x7 for co-sell eligibility.
- We need a single canonical support email/portal link for the listing and one escalation contact (name + phone) that we can surface to partners.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Marissa to review brand pack and propose marketplace-safe product copy.
2) Ben to confirm any legal redlines for the listing text and required disclaimers.
3) If 24x7 is needed by Procurement/MarketplaceOps, confirm whether Acme will offer it as an add-on; if yes, provide pricing and manifest text.

I'll also attach a draft listing copy and our standard support wording for your procurement team to review.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
(attachment: listing-copy-draft.md (MD))

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: dylan.brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jan 2029 18:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: branding & SLA preflight

Thanks for the ping — quick take from GTM:

- I reviewed acme-brand-guidelines.pdf. Logos look fine; two asks: please provide a 1:1 square logo for marketplace tiles (SVG) and a 300px wide PNG for preview. Also confirm the product display name (legal vs marketing).
- Copy: avoid absolute uptime claims ("99.99% guaranteed") unless Acme has an SLA with measurable credits. Use: "Designed for XX availability; see support page for details."
- Support: For co-sell ops, MarketplaceOps prefers that the public listing shows the baseline hours (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00 CET) and a line "Optional 24x7 premium support available." That satisfies most channel reviewers and keeps expectations correct. If Acme wants eligibility for certain partner programs, they should plan for a paid 24x7 SKU.

I'll draft a short blurb for the product listing and flag any policy phrases to avoid. Ben — can you confirm if the trademark footnote in the brand PDF is sufficient or if Acme needs to sign anything else?

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Marketplace, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, dylan.brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Audrey Li <audrey@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jan 2029 09:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: branding & SLA preflight

Looping in a short legal checklist for Acme's team:

- Trademark and logo clearance: the brand pack is fine; we need a written confirmation from Acme that they own the marks or have permission to use partner marks (a single-line confirmation in email is acceptable).
- Claims: remove absolute service guarantees unless accompanied by an SLA doc that defines credits/metrics. We can accept "target availability" language.
- Data residency / compliance callouts: if the listing mentions EU data residency, include link to the DPA or product docs — we will not allow unsupported residency claims on the marketplace page.

Audrey — if you can reply with a short note confirming trademark ownership and whether you plan to publish a paid 24x7 offering, we can finalize the listing copy. I can also provide a one-page SLA template if that helps.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

- Trademark: Acme confirms we own the marks used in the attached brand pack; we grant Redwood permission to display logos and the product name in marketplace listings. Consider this email our written confirmation.

- Data residency: The product stores telemetry in EU customer regions; we'll share the DPA link by Friday.

Next actions from Acme: upload the square SVG and a 300px PNG, and confirm final product display name.
